Retrieve Lobbying Organization Names and Register Identifiers

eulob_lobbies.Rd

Retrieves name-to-register-identifier relationships from the bundled EU-LOB catalogue, with optional territorial and register filters.

Usage

eulob_lobbies(country = NULL, register = NULL, data_dir = NULL)

Arguments

country

Optional territorial code such as `"ES"` or `"UE"`. The code is converted to uppercase.

register

Optional single register name. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.

data_dir

Must be `NULL`. External catalogue directories are not supported in this version.

Value

A data frame with six columns:

name_id

Identifier associated with a normalized name.

name

Recorded organization name.

name_normalized

Normalized form used for searching and ordering.

country

Territorial or register code.

register

Name of the source register.

lobby_id

Register-specific entry identifier.

Filters without matches return a zero-row data frame.

Details

Each row represents a recorded relationship between a name and an identifier in a lobbying register. Rows should not be interpreted as globally deduplicated legal entities.

`name_id` identifies a normalized name in the catalogue. `lobby_id` is the identifier supplied for a register entry; its format varies across registers and may be a URL.

Results are ordered by normalized name, territorial code and register identifier. Register filtering uses exact matching.

See also

[eulob_search()], [eulob_registers()]

head(eulob_lobbies(country = "ES"))
